$comment: Markdown policy per CLAUDE.md: 80-column prose wrap, ATX headings, one-sentence-per-line acceptable in long-form docs.

MD033.$comment: Inline HTML is needed for the front-matter template's checklist comment, for admonition markup, for the ESP Web Tools install button on the CYD scan-control panel page, and for the Scalar mount point + loader/init script on the API reference page (a JS-rendered component, no Markdown/fenced-code equivalent exists for any of these).

$comment-MD046: Disabled: markdownlint parses the indented body of a Zensical/Material admonition (!!! note) as an indented code block, so every admonition would be a false positive. There is no way to distinguish the two, and admonitions are used throughout the docs tree.

MD025.$comment: Pages may carry a front-matter `title` (browser/nav title) AND a body H1 (rendered heading). Zensical does not inject a heading from front matter, so both are needed and must not count as two titles.

MD024.$comment: Repeated headings are fine across different sections (e.g. 'Pros' under each topology).
